# Ruby Gillis

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis possesses showy looks, characterized by a plump figure and a brilliant complexion. She has large, bright-blue eyes and wears her hair in a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who laughs frequently and frankly enjoys life's simple pleasures, though she can be inclined to hysterics and harbors a mortal fear of fat green caterpillars. Her future ambitions center heavily on romance; she intends to have numerous suitors devoted to her, plans to acquire a beau by age fifteen, and envisions teaching for only two years before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis once charmed all her warts away using a magic pebble given to her by old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek. She later joined her friends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) in dramatizing the story of Elaine, during which Anne's boat sank and forced a rescue by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Ruby eventually attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and a close group of ambitious classmates, anxiously preparing for their spring examinations and discussing commencement attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P18](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two walk home together and share their thoughts on recitations, and Ruby participates in dramatic games with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their peers, such as a reenactment of Elaine that ended with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) needing rescue from a sinking flat.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--ruby-gillis.md)
